text: There were some who took upon them to cavil at all this, as not consistent with his usual calmness and moderation, not discerning that though he were steadfast, firm, and inflexible to pleasure, fear, or foolish entreaties, yet he was full of natural tenderness and brotherly affection.
author: Plutarch
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
